headline.tier: Semantic Memory + Transitive Inference: 65% direct + 90% chained recall multi-seed
headline.result: Real semantic association memory with TRANSITIVE INFERENCE. Direct recall (user types 'apple' -> system retrieves 'big'): 65% multi-seed via pool-firing readout. Chained inference (train apple<->big and big<->hot -> query apple -> retrieve 'hot'): 90% multi-seed. Concept-output conversation, NO motor routing.
headline.metrics: Concept-concept (NO motor) multi-seed v16 8-pair: 23/40 stim-recall (57.5%) + 12/40 associative-recall (30%). Compose capacity ladder (motor-routed, separate track): 1-pair 100%, 2-pair 100% (up to 48), 3-word 100% motor/85% full, 4-word 100% motor/60% full multi-seed. v17 28-word vocab + 96 cross-pair: 96/96 PERFECT seed 42 (motor-routed). 3 seeds v17 confirmed PERFECT before cancelled.
headline.wall_clock: ~17 min/seed v14/v16 Phase 1 + ~30s/seed engram encoding+recall + ~10s/seed chat REPL setup. Full demo end-to-end: ~18 min/seed.
headline.summary: ALL THREE user-stated blockers (concepts, composition, diversity) validated. ARCHITECTURAL PIVOT 2026-05-14: previous compose tests were vocabulary-rich MOTOR DIRECTION routing (cue -> N/E/S/W). User correctly identified this isn't real semantic conversation. Pivoted to concept-concept engrams (NO motor in tag): encode (apple, big) -> stimulate tag -> lang_output spells BOTH 'apple' and 'big'. Multi-seed v16 8-pair: 23/40 stim-recall (57.5%, both concepts in top-5), 12/40 associative-recall (30%, drive a alone, b appears in non-a top-3). compose_concept_chat.py operational - user types 'apple', system associates 'big'/'cat'/etc. Real semantic memory foundation. Quality is ~30-60% multi-seed; above chance but room for improvement (longer encoding, denser association graph, stronger Phase 1 readout).

pillars.name: 48-pair compose engram - PERFECT 240/240 multi-seed (5/5 seeds 48/48)
pillars.metric: 12 cues (4 verb + 4 noun + 4 adj) x 4 motors = 48 compositional units. 100% recall across all 5 seeds with motor teacher current. Demonstrates 48-distinct-memory capacity in single bridge.

pillars.name: 3-word phrases (adj+noun+motor) - tuned 20/20 motor + 17/20 full multi-seed
pillars.metric: 5/5 seeds: motor recall 4/4 each (20/20 PERFECT); full 3-way pool recall 4+4+4+2+3 = 17/20 (85%). Tuned: motor_teacher_pA=750, top_k=250.

pillars.name: 4-word phrases (verb+adj+noun+motor) - 20/20 motor + 12/20 full multi-seed
pillars.metric: 5/5 seeds: motor recall 4/4 each (20/20 PERFECT); full 4-way pool recall 3+3+3+2+1 = 12/20 (60%). Tuned: motor_teacher_pA=750, top_k=400.

pillars.name: TRANSITIVE SEMANTIC INFERENCE - 90% multi-seed (chained A->C via B)
pillars.metric: v16 5-seed 4 chains each: Direct A->B 17/20 (85%); Chained A->C via B 18/20 (90%). Train apple<->big and big<->hot, query apple, retrieve hot. Chain recall HIGHER than direct - distributed activation propagates through learned association graph.

pillars.name: Concept-Concept Pool-Firing Readout - 65% multi-seed (chat-usable)
pillars.metric: v16 multi-seed 5x8 pairs: 26/40 (65%) associative recall via pool-firing rank (vs 12/40=30% with cosine spelling). Drive cue, rank concept pools by firing rate, return top-3 non-cue. Significantly above chance.

pillars.name: Compose-Engram + Chat REPL - 12-word vocab 91.7% motor recall multi-seed (motor-routed track)
pillars.metric: Chat REPL 12-pair multi-seed: 55/60 motor recall (91.7%); 3/5 seeds perfect 12/12. Note: this is motor-direction routing, not semantic memory.

pillars.name: Engram + motor teacher: PERFECT 4-pair compose multi-seed
pillars.metric: 5/5 seeds 4/4 PERFECT (20/20 total) with --motor-teacher-pA 1500. TRUE rank 1/24 unanimously (mathematically unique at 4/4 max). +20pp improvement over base engram (16/20).

pillars.name: Sequential composition (verb-then-motor temporal drive)
pillars.metric: 5-seed: 16/20 cosine retrieve (80%) + 20/20 recall (100% PERFECT). Engram captures spikes across temporal windows. Real conversation pattern works.

pillars.name: Engram-Composition (catalog D.14 Tonegawa) - original 4-pair baseline
pillars.metric: 5/5 seeds: 16/20 PASS (80%); TRUE mapping rank 1/24 UNANIMOUS across all seeds (chance=12.5/24). Two seeds (43, 45) achieve 4/4 perfect.

pillars.name: v16 + Compose-Training (STDP-pathway) - NEGATIVE, superseded by engram approach
pillars.metric: Direct-drive test: 1500 pA on verb_pool produces motor firing 0.001-0.005 (essentially zero, 100x lower than lang_input rates). 0/4 compose pairs PASS, TRUE rank 15/24 (BELOW chance). STDP doesn't grow verb_pool->motor weights to functional magnitude over 100-400 compose events.

pillars.name: STP DEFAULT FLIPPED — 3.28x faster + accuracy improved
pillars.metric: 3-seed validation: wall clock 506s vs 1660s (3.28x); A2W primary 100% vs 87.5% (+12.5pp); W2A 52% vs 35% (+17pp). STP was 57% of inner-loop step time AND degrading binding via millisecond synaptic fatigue. Default flipped in chat training paths.

pillars.name: Encoding-axis 64-word 3-seed — capacity rule revised
pillars.metric: 3/3 GO unanimous. Retention primary 110% +/- 23%, synonym 119% +/- 34%. Wall clock 954s +/- 7s (35x faster than prior 9.4 hr baseline). User's encoding-vs-motor hypothesis confirmed: n_motor=2000 + n_lang=8192 outperforms n_motor=6000 + n_lang=4096 at 64-word vocab. New rule: lang_input encoding is rate-limiting, not motor capacity.

capacity_rule.rule: REVISED 2026-05-10: encoding-axis architecture recommended for vocab >= 32. Motor capacity matters less than encoding capacity at higher vocab tiers. Encoding (n_lang_input) is rate-limiting; motor pool just needs ~125 neurons/sub-pop to support STDP convergence.

phase_status.active: Encoding-axis architecture VALIDATED 3-seed. Combined opt stack: STP-off + encoding-axis = 35x speedup AND better retention. Recommended baseline for vocab >= 32 words. Capacity rule revised. Tier 2.3 phrases needs STP-off revalidation (silent flip risk).
phase_status.next: Launch 128-word + 256-word encoding-axis smokes (~30-60 min each) to validate true encoding-wall ceiling. Re-run Tier 2.3 phrases at STP-off (architecture was limited at 41% with STP-on; STP-off may improve or degrade).
phase_status.after_next: Re-validate prior Tier 1 + Tier 2.1 + Phase 1.4 multi-seed results at STP-off + new architecture. Predicted to push numbers significantly higher.
